title: An Advanced Decision Support Tool for Personalized Medicine for IVF Using Modeling and Optimization for Provera
official: An Advanced Decision Support Tool for Personalized Medicine for IVF Using Modeling and Optimization for PPOS
summary: A clinical trial will determine the effectiveness of using the Opt-IVF decision support tool for each patient's personalized and optimal drug dosage profile in the United States.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* infertile women

Exclusion Criteria:

All female patients who will not undergo IVF or whose cycles will be converted to IUI. Male patients will not be enrolled in this study. No donor cycles.
